llmsSummary: MyMemos is a free, local-first Chrome extension that replaces your New Tab page with a private notes workspace. Notes stay on your device in IndexedDB-no account, no cloud sync, no server. Includes a Notion-style block editor, fuzzy search (⌘K), and seven themes.

faq.question: What is MyMemos?
faq.answer: MyMemos is a free Chrome extension that replaces your browser's New Tab with a local-first notes workspace. Every time you open a new tab, your notes are ready-no separate app to launch.

faq.question: Is MyMemos free?
faq.answer: Yes. MyMemos is free and open source (MIT license). There is no subscription, account, or paid tier.

faq.question: Does MyMemos require an account or cloud sync?
faq.answer: No. MyMemos works entirely offline. Your notes are stored locally in your browser using IndexedDB. Nothing is sent to a server.

faq.question: Where is my data stored in MyMemos?
faq.answer: All notes and settings stay on your device. Page content lives in IndexedDB; preferences use chrome.storage.local in the extension (or localStorage in the web demo).

faq.question: How is MyMemos different from Notion or Evernote?
faq.answer: MyMemos lives on your New Tab, not a separate website or app. It is local-first and private by default: no login, no sync servers, and no cloud dependency. Best for quick capture when you hit ⌘T.

faq.question: Can I try MyMemos before installing the Chrome extension?
faq.answer: Yes. A live browser demo is available here. Same UI as the extension, using localStorage instead of chrome.storage.
